write_series.what: start_attempt: job FOR SHARE, run FOR NO KEY UPDATE, count attempts, swap the run to RUNNING, insert the attempt; commit runs the deferred checks
heartbeat: renew the lease of a live attempt
append_ledger_entry: lock the job and read the head, insert the entry (trigger re-verifies the hash), move the head
enqueue_event: insert one outbox row (deferred aggregate check at commit)
index_artifact: check the origin, insert, read back
audit append: the trigger takes the tenant's advisory lock, reads the tail, hashes

steps.label: baseline: about 900 READY runs, 10 percent of them belong to a paused job
5,000 more READY runs at the head of the queue whose jobs are PAUSED (the claim must skip them)
plus 20,000 READY runs of ACTIVE jobs behind them (a burst of admitted jobs)

SELECT s.tenant_id, s.job_id, s.id, s.version, s.not_before FROM stage_runs s JOIN jobs j ON j.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND j.id = s.job_id A
UPDATE attempts SET lease_expires_at = now() + interval $1, last_heartbeat_at = now(), version = version + $2 WHERE tenant_id = $3::uuid AND
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (tenant_id, job_id, sequence, entry_id, stage_run_id, attempt_id, recorded_at, execution_mode, recorded_component
UPDATE jobs SET ledger_head_sequence = seq, ledger_head_hash = hash WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant AND id = p_job
WITH c AS (SELECT seq FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY seq LIMIT $1 FOR NO KEY UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE outbox o SET publis
